subject: round g9 (after chin_lit 0.5), face_g9.png
reference_style: Monster Hunter Stories 3 (MHS3) anime toon style, male protagonist

jaw_and_chin.reference: in 3/4 the jawline is a long straight diagonal from below the ear to a small, slightly squared chin; the chin is narrow
jaw_and_chin.ours: in 3/4 the jawline is a nearly straight diagonal from below the ear to a small chin; in front the jaw forms a V to a small rounded chin

chin_width.reference: the chin, just above its tip, is about 0.25 of the face width at eye level (measured in the 3/4 frame)
chin_width.ours: the chin, just above its tip, is about 0.27 of the face width at eye level (measured in front)

face_shadow.reference: the front of the face, including the chin, is fully lit; on the far side a narrow shadow band runs along the cheek edge from the temple to the jaw with a smooth clean edge; the shadow under the jaw falls on the neck, not on the chin (the skull is hidden under hair)
face_shadow.ours: in front the chin and the centre of the jaw are lit; a shadow band runs along the far cheek edge from the temple down, and a smaller patchy shadow with a ragged edge sits on the far lower jaw corner just above the neck; in 3/4 the shadow covers the far third of the face from the temple to the jaw with a jagged stepped edge, and the chin front is lit (skull ignored: hidden by hair in the reference)

outline.reference: a clear dark-brown outline around the face and jaw, about as thick as the upper lid line
outline.ours: a medium-brown outline around the face and jaw, about as thick as the upper lid line, lighter than the lid line

skin_colour.reference: warm peach skin with warm orange-brown shadow
skin_colour.ours: warm peach skin with warm orange-brown shadow

nose_profile.reference: in 3/4 a straight nose bridge ending in a small pointed tip
nose_profile.ours: in 3/4 a straight nose bridge ending in a small pointed tip
